proposed.explanation: The investor wants to add a fertilizer exporter for diversification, aligning with purchasing shares in Abu Qir Fertilizers (ABUK). We use the verified per-share earnings of 8.74 EGP for the nine months ended 30 September 2026 [ABUK-ABUK_9M2026_results-p2-31] and 4.28 EGP for the prior period [ABUK-ABUK_9M2026_results-p2-32], while marking the ambiguous revenue and net profit figures as unused due to conflicting unit indicators in the source report. With available cash of 40,000.00 EGP and a share price of 76.21 EGP, buying 500 shares costs 38,105.00 EGP, leaving 1,895.00 EGP in cash. The total portfolio value becomes 40,000.00 EGP (cash) + 25,600.00 EGP (COMI holdings: 200 shares at 128.00 EGP) + 38,105.00 EGP (ABUK holdings: 500 shares at 76.21 EGP) = 103,705.00 EGP. The new ABUK holding represents approximately 36.74% of the total portfolio value, complying with the diversification rule that no single company may exceed 50%. This guidance carries market uncertainty and risks of share price volatility.
